Read/search/index the relevant state/reader implementation, preserve the specified current behavior, and validate your repair. Never hardcode fixture values/IDs, application names or properties, inspect verifier infrastructure, fabricate observations or modify dependencies. Marked context compression may shorten earlier messages; complete raw calls/results remain archived. Finish with a brief report even if the patch is incomplete. Independent checks, not your self-report, determine acceptance.
